description: This file defines the IDGeneratorDao class, which provides methods to retrieve and update unique IDs for entities in the OrangeHRM system database. It interacts with the UniqueId entity and manages ID generation logic within the ORM framework.

classes.name: IDGeneratorDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for generating and managing unique IDs for entities in the database.

methods.name: getCurrentID
methods.description: Retrieves the current last used ID for a given entity class from the database.

methods.name: updateNextId
methods.description: Updates the last used ID for a specified entity class in the database.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Private helper method that retrieves the table name associated with the provided entity class.
